AXIS_FRICTION.rationale: Variants are axis-resolved (A1_A .. A6_B); the anomaly is a deviation of the friction parameters in the axis friction law.

AXIS_WEIGHT.rationale: Variants are axis-resolved with three magnitudes (A1_115G .. A6_500G); the anomaly is an inertial-parameter deviation of the corresponding link.

MOTOR_COMMUTATION.rationale: Variants are axis-resolved (A1_HIGH .. A6_MEDIUM); a commutation offset scales the electromagnetic torque relation tau_m = Kt*iq.

COLLISION_FOAM.rationale: Contact with a foam obstacle injects an external torque into the rigid-body row of whichever axes carry the contact wrench.

COLLISION_CABLE.rationale: As COLLISION_FOAM; the obstacle differs, the structural location does not.

ENTANGLED.rationale: A snagged cable applies a sustained external wrench; same structural location as a collision.

MISS_CAN.rationale: The gripper carries no workpiece, so the payload mass parameter deviates from nominal by the full can mass.

LOSE_CAN.rationale: The workpiece is released mid-trajectory: the same payload parameter, with a step in time rather than at t=0.

CAN_WEIGHT.rationale: The can is heavier or lighter than nominal: payload parameter deviation.

INVALID_POSITION.rationale: EXCLUDED. The plant is healthy; the reference trajectory is wrong. This is a deviation of a known input, not of a model equation or parameter, so it has no structural fault location.

WOBBLING_STATION.rationale: EXCLUDED. A compliant/moving base adds degrees of freedom that the fixed-base model does not contain. It is unmodelled dynamics, not a parameter deviation, and belongs to the model-mismatch experiment instead.

excluded_channels.motor_torque_i: firmware estimate Kt*iq, not an independent sensor
excluded_channels.power_load_mech_i: product of joint torque and joint_velocity
excluded_channels.motor_id_i: d-axis current, regulated to zero, no structural role
excluded_channels.supply_voltage_i / brake_voltage_i: DC-link and brake rails, not in the drivetrain equations
excluded_channels.target_*: reference trajectory, entered as a known input instead
